HTML login form tutorial

This tutorial explains how password fields work in HTML forms and how browsers submit credentials. A real application verifies those credentials on the server. The example below is documentation rather than a login gate. Readable article content must remain importable even when it demonstrates password and sign-in controls. Accessibility labels, form semantics, autocomplete values, validation states and safe server-side handling are all part of the lesson.

A tutorial may include several examples in sequence. The extractor should keep the surrounding paragraphs and omit the interactive form controls from the document body, while preserving the article as readable technical content.
